games.name: Minecraft
games.platform: PC, Mobile, PS3, PS4, PS5, Xbox 360, Xbox One, Xbox Series X, Xbox Series S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2
games.description: Minecraft is a 3D sandbox video game made of blocks where players explore, gather resources, and build anything they can imagine.

games.name: Red Dead Redemption 2
games.description: Red Dead Redemption 2 is an open-world action-adventure game set in the American Wild West, following Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang.

games.name: The Last of Us
games.description: The Last of Us is a post-apocalyptic action-adventure game following Joel and Ellie as they travel across the United States searching for a possible cure.

games.name: The Last of Us Part II
games.description: The Last of Us Part II is a story-driven action-adventure game that follows Ellie through a brutal journey of survival, revenge, and loss.

games.name: A Plague Tale: Innocence
games.platform: PC, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X, Xbox Series S, Nintendo Switch
games.description: A Plague Tale: Innocence is a story-driven action-adventure game following Amicia and her younger brother Hugo as they survive war, the Inquisition, and swarms of rats in medieval France.

games.name: EA Sports FC 26
games.platform: PC, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X, Xbox Series S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2
games.description: EA Sports FC 26 is a football simulation game featuring real-world teams, players, competitions, and multiple game modes.

games.name: Dark Souls
games.platform: PC, PS3, PS4, Xbox 360, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch
games.description: Dark Souls is a challenging action RPG known for its interconnected world, difficult combat, mysterious lore, and unforgiving enemies.

games.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
games.platform: PC, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X, Xbox Series S, Nintendo Switch
games.description: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is an open-world action RPG following Geralt of Rivia as he searches for Ciri across a vast fantasy world filled with quests, monsters, and political conflicts.

games.name: R.E.P.O.
games.description: R.E.P.O. is a cooperative horror game where players work together to collect valuable items while trying to survive terrifying monsters and unpredictable situations.

games.name: Lethal Company
games.description: Lethal Company is a cooperative horror game where players explore abandoned moons, collect scrap, and try to meet their company's profit quota while surviving dangerous creatures.

games.name: Escape the Backrooms
games.description: Escape the Backrooms is a cooperative horror game where players explore mysterious and terrifying levels inspired by the Backrooms while solving puzzles and trying to escape.
